policy: Strictly open source: every executable shipped with the downloader is built from published source with the recorded build script, and the corresponding licence travels with it.
No generic bypass, cracked licence, shared account, or pre-baked credential is hardcoded anywhere in the tool. Google Play enforces ownership.
Account credentials move only between the device and Google. Nothing is stored on, proxied through, or transmitted to a third-party server.

binaries.role: Downloads the account holder's own entitled Play package.
binaries.notes: Cross-built from the pinned upstream commit. Byte-for-byte reproduction needs the same Ubuntu 24.04 protoc and headers the build script documents.

binaries.role: Exchanges Google's one-shot approval for the saved Play session.
binaries.notes: Built from the same upstream commit and build script as gplaydl.

binaries.role: Hosts Google's own embedded sign-in page and adds handheld controller navigation.
binaries.notes: Built in the container recipe beside the source. The Debian base image is not digest-pinned yet, so rebuilds match functionally rather than byte-for-byte.

binaries.role: Answers Qt's two XCB GLX capability probes on PortMaster's headless XWayland. Implements no rendering.
binaries.notes: Single C file compiled with the aarch64 cross toolchain named in the build script.

pinned_downloads.role: Optional Qt 6 WebEngine runtime for the sign-in window. Fetched from the official upstream release only after the user chooses the downloader; never redistributed here.
Qt virtual-keyboard input-context plugin for controller text entry. Fetched from Debian; never redistributed here.

network.rule: Every host the downloader can reach is listed here. Only hosts owned by Google may see account data; no other host is contacted while credentials exist in memory.

allowed.purpose: Google's own embedded Android sign-in page, rendered locally in the Qt WebEngine view. The password and phone approval never leave this page.
Play auth, checkin, and delivery endpoints called directly by gplaydl/gplayver on the device.
Pinned, checksum-verified upstream launcher AppImage download.
Redirect target GitHub uses to serve the pinned AppImage. Never contacted with credentials.
Pinned, checksum-verified Qt virtual-keyboard plugin package.
URL that appears inside the bundled Apache-2.0 licence text only.
